summary: Database completion removes the backend blocker; backend implementation and subsequent QA/security review are now scheduled.

new_tasks.title: Implement `server.py` REST and static-file server using the completed `database.py` repository; support GET, POST, PATCH/PUT, and DELETE task endpoints.
Verify API CRUD, valid status moves, invalid input responses, and the static UI workflow after the server is available.
Review `server.py` for request-size limits, JSON/path validation, error handling, and safe static-file resolution.

messages.content: Database is ready and your dependency is cleared. Implement server.py against its repository contract, including PATCH compatibility for the existing UI.
Prepare end-to-end verification once backend-02 completes.
Review server input and static-serving behavior after backend-02 completes.

decisions: The backend must support PATCH as well as PUT because the completed static UI uses PATCH for edits and status moves.
QA and security begin only after the server integrates the database repository.
